summary: Chesapeake Utilities filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Peninsula Pipeline Holdings sold a 49% membership interest in Florida Energy Pathway LLC, owner of the Florida Energy Pathway Project, to NextEra Energy Resources' affiliate FEP Pipeline Holdings. Peninsula retains 51% and management control via a Management Committee with unanimous pre-in-service approval and 67% post-in-service threshold. Terms include no stated price or premium. The transaction creates a joint venture to finance infrastructure. Monitor regulatory approvals and project construction milestones.
